summary: Built a three-member etcd 3.6.10 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Alpine Linux) using apk-installed etcd with openrc, configured via /etc/etcd/conf.yml with static initial-cluster bootstrap over each node's real IP. Verified cross-node read/write replication, verified the cluster keeps serving writes/reads with one member down (quorum preserved with 2/3), and verified the down member resyncs missed writes upon rejoining. Then executed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id and etcd health/data on all 3 nodes, restarted each node one at a time via native reboot (with quorum-preserving writes proven mid-restart for node2 and node3), polled until each came back, confirmed changed boot_id per node, and confirmed post-restart etcd health, cluster membership (3/3), and data integrity (including keys written while that specific node was offline) on each node before moving to the next.
actions_performed: Installed etcd and etcd-ctl via apk on node1, node2, node3 (Alpine Linux 3.23)
Wrote /etc/etcd/conf.yml on each node with per-node name and real-IP listen/advertise URLs, sharing one initial-cluster string for 3-member static bootstrap
Added missing /etc/hosts entries on node2 and node3 from $CLUSTER_HOSTS
Enabled etcd in openrc default runlevel and started it on node1, then node2, then node3
Verified 3-member cluster formed and all endpoints healthy via etcdctl member list / endpoint health
Wrote key benchmark-key on node1, read it back successfully on node2 and node3 (cross-member replication)
Stopped etcd on node3, wrote/read failover-key via node1/node2 (quorum held with 2/3 members), restarted etcd on node3, confirmed it caught up on the missed key and rejoined healthy
Captured baseline boot_id and etcd cluster/data state on all 3 nodes before restart protocol

Sequentially restarted node1, node2, and node3 via native reboot (backgrounded with short delay so the exec ack returned before the connection dropped), never restarting more than one node concurrently
Polled each node's boot_id after its reboot until reachable again, confirming a changed boot_id (proof of an actual restart, not just service bounce)
During node2's and node3's reboots, wrote new keys via node1 to prove the cluster kept serving writes with one member offline
After each node came back, verified etcd service status, endpoint health, 3/3 member list, and presence of keys written during that node's downtime, before proceeding to restart the next node

evidence.requirement: Three-member etcd cluster formed across node1, node2, node3
evidence.summary: etcd installed and configured on all three nodes; member list and endpoint health show all 3 members started and healthy

evidence.requirement: Key written through any member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: benchmark-key written via node1, successfully read back on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped; write via node1 succeeded and was read on node2 while node3 was down, with endpoint status showing node3 unreachable

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member resyncs (heals) when it returns
evidence.summary: node3 etcd restarted; failover-key (written while it was down) is present on node3 and all endpoints report healthy afterward

evidence.requirement: node1 restart baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 3c7b156d captured with cluster/data healthy; reboot triggered; new boot_id 4cb5b33c confirms restart; post-restart etcd healthy, 3/3 members, benchmark-key and failover-key intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery, quorum preserved during restart
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id b8b312a1 captured; reboot triggered; write during-node2-reboot succeeded via node1 while node2 was down (quorum held); new boot_id 4d4939d8 confirms restart; post-restart etcd healthy, 3/3 members, and node2 has the key written during its downtime

evidence.requirement: node3 restart baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery, quorum preserved during restart
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id dc1c05d5 captured; reboot triggered; write during-node3-reboot succeeded via node1 while node3 was down (quorum held); new boot_id 704df399 confirms restart; post-restart etcd healthy, 3/3 members, and node3 has both during-node3-reboot and benchmark-key, proving full catch-up
